name: book-translate-lite
description: Translate a whole book (EPUB/PDF/DOCX) into any language, end to end, with a final review and EPUB/DOCX/PDF output, using very few tokens.

interface.shortDescription: Translate whole books into any language, end to end.
interface.longDescription: Converts an EPUB/PDF/DOCX into parts, translates them in parallel with automatic checks, runs a final review and builds EPUB, DOCX and PDF. The orchestrator is a script, so it uses very few tokens.
defaultPrompt: How is my book translation going?
Rerun the final review of my translation.
